clue.text: Eating up some fish, females here instructed

parts.note: eating up a meal is finishing it
a school is a shoal, a group of fish swimming together

explanation.surface: Someone eats up a fish supper while women are being taught.
explanation.walkthrough: The definition is a descriptive phrase: a place where young women were once taught social graces.
explanation.definitionFit: A finishing school was an establishment where young ladies learned etiquette and deportment before entering society.

clue.text: Breaking free, I might not be currently

clue.text: Just beginning new climb

clue.text: One Murdoch hailing originally from Dublin

clue.text: Moves perhaps from A to B without stopping?

clue.text: Apparition left Scots horsemen rattled as knight invades

clue.text: Rotter succeeded in high shoes
